title: 第12章 结善缘
content_zh:
“孙师兄，你也快突破到练气三层了吧？”

    孙康临走之时，韩榆问了一声。

    说起这件事，孙康也面露期待神色：“若是灵米充足，再有半年，就差不多了！”

    “对了，一月之后，我们的灵田也要收获了，你们到时候可以跟着看看收获灵田的注意事项，积累些经验。”

    等他走后，韩榆说道：“孙师兄可真是个热心肠的好人，希望他尽早顺利突破，进入外门吧。”

    李老道也嘶哑着声音：“的确不坏。”

    又带着几分羡慕：“他也要练气三层了……”

    匆忙回去修炼去了。

    韩榆也巡视一遍灵田，之后开始了自己的修行。

    复制灵米饭团吃下，气流周天循环，带来丝丝缕缕的增长，最后归入丹田处那微小的灵气种子之中。

    练气的气流之始从丹田起，最后又归入丹田，气流行遍周身，最后的细微增加，也还是归于丹田之中。

    循环一个周天之后，灵米饭团带来的灵气便已经被消化殆尽；再继续修炼，单纯靠四灵根的资质吸纳天地间零散灵气，速度陡然变慢，效果也差了很多。

    “每日复制一个灵米饭团，有些不够用，而且四灵根资质也的确差了些……”

    韩榆正思忖着，门口传来轻微的翅膀扇动声响。

    打开门，羽毛光亮的大乌鸦飞进来，后面还跟了一只寻常大小的乌鸦。

    一大一小两只乌鸦一起瞧着他，也不出声。

    韩榆好笑：“我让你帮我寻找灵草，你倒是会自己找伴！”

    大乌鸦轻叫一声：“嘎。”

    “你是说，多一个帮你的，更好找？”

    “嘎。”

    韩榆笑了一下：“行吧，这也算有点道理，难怪你这几天下来一点收获都没有。”

    “嘎。”大乌鸦委屈地叫了一声，跳着身子到一旁去了。

    韩榆凝出精血，运起养灵术，投入新带来的乌鸦口中。
content_en:
"Senior Brother Sun, are you about to break through to the third level of Qi training?"

When Sun Kang was leaving, Han Yu asked.

Speaking of this matter, Sun Kang also looked expectant: "If there is enough spiritual rice, it will be almost done in half a year!"

"By the way, our spiritual fields will be harvested in one month. Then you can follow the precautions for harvesting spiritual fields and accumulate some experience."

After he left, Han Yu said: "Senior Brother Sun is really a warm-hearted and good man. I hope he can successfully break through and enter the outer gate as soon as possible."

Li Laodao also said hoarsely: "It's indeed not bad."

With a bit of envy: "He is also going to practice the third level of Qi..."

He hurried back to practice.

Han Yu also visited the spiritual field and then started his own practice.

After eating the rice balls that replicate the spiritual energy, the air current circulates around the sky, bringing about growth in threads, and finally merges into the tiny spiritual energy seeds in the Dantian.

The Qi flow of Qi training starts from the Dantian, and finally returns to the Dantian. The Qi flows all over the body, and the final subtle increase still returns to the Dantian.

After a cycle of one week, the spiritual energy brought by the spiritual rice balls has been completely digested; if you continue to practice, relying solely on the qualifications of the four spiritual roots to absorb the scattered spiritual energy between heaven and earth, the speed suddenly slows down and the effect is much worse.

"Copying one spiritual rice ball every day is not enough, and the qualifications of the Four Spiritual Roots are indeed somewhat inferior..."

Han Yu was thinking about it when a slight sound of wings flapping came from the door.

Opening the door, a large crow with shiny feathers flew in, followed by an ordinary-sized crow.

Two crows, one large and one small, looked at him without making a sound.

Han Yu was amused: "I asked you to help me find spiritual herbs, but you know how to find a companion by yourself!"

The big crow cried softly: "Gah."

"You mean, it would be easier to find someone to help you?"

"Gah."

Han Yu smiled: "Okay, this makes sense. No wonder you haven't gained anything in the past few days."

"Gah." The big crow cried out in grievance and jumped to the side.

Han Yu condensed the essence and blood, used the spirit nourishing technique, and put it into the mouth of the newly brought crow.
